paper.title: DESI 2024 VI: Cosmological Constraints from the Measurements of Baryon Acoustic Oscillations
truncated_sections: Appendix A Comparison of results from DESI and combined DESI+SDSS BAO data
Appendix B Comparison to Planck PR4 likelihoods

result.summary: 本文报告了DESI第一年观测（DR1）中星系、类星体和莱曼α森林示踪物的重子声学振荡（BAO）测量所得到的宇宙学结果，在0.1<z<4.2的七个红移区间内提供了相对于声视界的横向共动距离和哈勃率的稳健测量 [abstract]。DESI BAO数据单独与平坦ΛCDM模型一致，得到物质密度Ωm=0.295±0.015 [abstract]；结合BBN和CMB声学角尺度先验，得到H0=(68.52±0.62) km/s/Mpc [abstract]。在扩展模型中，当暗能量状态方程随时间变化时，DESI与CMB或超新星的组合偏好w0>-1和wa<0，与ΛCDM的差异在2.5σ至3.9σ之间 [abstract]。这些结果为偏离标准宇宙学模型提供了 tantalizing 的暗示，并展示了DESI在揭示暗能量本质方面的潜力 [S8.p7]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在利用DESI第一年观测的BAO测量，在多个红移区间内稳健地测量宇宙膨胀历史，并对标准ΛCDM模型及其扩展（包括暗能量动力学、空间曲率、中微子质量等）进行检验 [abstract][S1.p8]。研究动机在于：当前宇宙学参数约束大体上与ΛCDM一致，但暗能量动力学尚未被严格检验，且存在哈勃张力等统计显著性张力，可能暗示超出ΛCDM的新物理 [S1.p3]。BAO作为一种对宇宙膨胀历史敏感的宇宙学探针，具有系统误差控制良好的特点，可用于检验暗能量动力学和空间曲率，并结合其他探针约束哈勃常数、中微子质量总和等 [S1.p5]。

evidence.quote: We present cosmological results from the measurement of baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO) in galaxy, quasar and Lyman- α \alpha forest tracers from the first year of observations from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI)
However, dark energy dynamics has not been stringently tested.
Such tensions, if not due to unaccounted systematics, may indicate new physics beyond $\Lambda$ CDM.
BAO provides a key cosmological probe sensitive to the cosmic expansion history, with well-controlled systematics.
Using BAO we can test for dark energy dynamics and spatial curvature, and in combination with other probes constrain the Hubble constant, the sum of neutrino masses, and the number of light species.
In this paper, we report the constraints derived from the measurements of baryon acoustic oscillations with the first year of data from DESI as part of a larger series of papers.

method.text: 论文采用BAO标准尺方法，通过测量星系、类星体和莱曼α森林示踪物的两点聚类来提取BAO尺度，并约束D_M/r_d、D_H/r_d或D_V/r_d等距离比率 [S2.SS3.p1][S2.SS3.p7]。分析中使用了盲分析框架以减轻确认偏差，对离散示踪物在目录层面进行盲化，对Lyα样本则通过向相关函数添加分量来移动BAO峰位置 [S2.SS3.SSS1.p2]。宇宙学推断使用cobaya结合CAMB玻尔兹曼代码，通过MCMC采样获得参数后验，并组合了BBN、CMB、SN Ia等外部数据集 [S2.SS5.p1][S2.SS5.p2][S2.SS5.p3]。

evidence.quote: We now briefly describe how DESI BAO analyses of DR1 data implement the standard ruler measurement.
As already mentioned, for the BGS and QSO tracers, we only measure the angle-averaged $D_{\mathrm{V}}/r_{\mathrm{d}}$ quantity, due to the lower signal-to-noise achieved.
For all other tracers, we quote results in $D_{\mathrm{M}}/r_{\mathrm{d}}$ and $D_{\mathrm{H}}/r_{\mathrm{d}}$, and provide the value of the correlation between them, $r$.

To mitigate against the possibility of such biases unknowingly entering into our analyses, we apply a system of blinding our data, to conceal the true cosmological results during the period where systematic errors were being investigated and analysis pipelines finalised.
For the discrete galaxy and quasar samples, blinding was applied at the catalog level, according to the procedure described and validated in.

For the Ly $\alpha$ sample, catalog-level blinding was challenging due to sky lines and Galactic absorption features located at known observed wavelengths in the spectra. Instead, the apparent position of the BAO peak was shifted by directly applying an additive component to the measured correlation functions, as described in.
We included in the cosmological inference code cobaya the PantheonPlus, Union3 and DESY5 SN Ia likelihoods, as well as our new DESI BAO likelihoods.
When running cobaya, we rely on the Boltzmann code CAMB for theoretical cosmology calculations.
All Bayesian inference is performed using the Metropolis-Hastings MCMC sampler in cobaya.

experiments.text: 分析使用了DESI DR1中超过600万个独特的外星系红移，涵盖BGS、LRG、ELG、QSO和Lyα森林示踪物，在七个红移区间内进行BAO测量 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p2]。外部数据集包括BBN先验、Planck和ACT的CMB数据（温度、极化及透镜）、以及三个SN Ia数据集（Pantheon+、Union3、DES-SN5YR） [S2.SS4.SSS1.p3][S2.SS4.SSS2.p3][S2.SS4.SSS3.p2]。宇宙学推断在平坦ΛCDM及其扩展模型中进行，采样参数包括Ωm、H0、w、w0、wa、ΩK、∑mν、Neff等 [S2.SS5.p3]。

evidence.quote: Overall, this analysis of the DESI Data Release 1 relies on over $6$ million unique redshifts, more than twice the number of redshifts considered in the final SDSS cosmological analysis.
Table 1 summarises the properties of the different samples used in this analysis, as well as the BAO measurements obtained from them using the methods described below.
We adopt these values as BBN priors in the following sections.

We use as our baseline the temperature (TT) and polarisation (EE) auto-spectra, plus their cross-spectra (TE), as incorporated in the simall, Commander (for multipoles $\ell<30$) and plik (for $\ell\geq 30$) likelihoods from the official PR3 release.
In this paper, we make use of three different SN Ia datasets.

We also consider extensions of the minimal $\Lambda$ CDM model in which other parameters are allowed to vary: the spatial curvature $\Omega_{\mathrm{K}}$, the sum of neutrino masses $\sum m_{\nu}$, the single constant dark energy equation of state parameter $w$ or the two parameters $(w_{0},w_{a})$ when allowing a time-varying equation of state $w(a)$, and the effective number of relativistic species $N_{\mathrm{eff}}$.

findings.text: DESI BAO数据单独与平坦ΛCDM一致，得到Ωm=0.295±0.015和r_d h=(101.8±1.3) Mpc [S4.SS1.p1]。结合BBN和θ*先验，得到H0=(68.52±0.62) km/s/Mpc，与SH0ES结果存在3.7σ张力 [S4.SS1.p4][S6.p2]。在w CDM模型中，DESI单独给出w=-0.99^{+0.15}_{-0.13}，与ΛCDM一致 [S5.SS1.p3]。在w0wa CDM模型中，DESI+CMB+SN Ia组合偏好w0>-1和wa<0，与ΛCDM的差异在2.5σ、3.5σ和3.9σ水平（分别对应Pantheon+、Union3和DESY5） [S5.SS2.p5]。中微子质量总和在ΛCDM下得到上限∑mν<0.072 eV（95% CL），但在扩展暗能量模型中放宽 [S7.SS1.p5][S7.SS1.p9]。

evidence.quote: The 68% credible-interval results for these parameters are $\left.\begin{aligned} \Omega_{\mathrm{m}}&=0.295\pm 0.015,\\ r_{\mathrm{d}}h&=(101.8\pm 1.3)\,\text{Mpc},\end{aligned}\ \right\}\ \ \mbox{\text{\parbox{42.67912pt}{\begin{flushleft}DESI~BAO, \end{flushleft}}}}$
in combination with BBN information, further tightens the $H_{0}$ result to $H_{0}=(68.52\pm 0.62)\;\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}\qquad(\mbox{DESI BAO\,+\,BBN\,+\,$\theta_{\ast}$}),$

As shown in Figure 10, while this DESI+BBN+ $\theta_{\ast}$ constraint is slightly higher than the Planck CMB value, it remains in tension (at the $3.7\sigma$ level) with the SH0ES Cepheid-based distance-ladder result $H_{0}=73.04\pm 1.04\;\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$

We find $\left.\begin{aligned} \Omega_{\mathrm{m}}&=0.293\pm 0.015,\\ w&=-0.99^{+0.15}_{-0.13},\end{aligned}\ \right\}\ \ \mbox{\text{\parbox{42.67912pt}{\begin{flushleft}DESI~BAO, \end{flushleft}}}}$
These correspond to preferences for a $w_{0}w_{a}$ CDM model over $\Lambda$ CDM model at the $2.5\sigma$, $3.5\sigma$ and $3.9\sigma$ significance levels, respectively.
while adding the DESI BAO data sharply reduces this to $\left.\sum m_{\nu}<0.072{\,\rm eV}\quad\mbox{\text{\parbox{113.81102pt}{\begin{flushleft}(95\,\%,~DESI~BAO+CMB). \end{flushleft}}}}\right.$
in a $w_{0}w_{a}$ CDM background, the upper limit from DESI BAO and CMB relaxes to $\sum m_{\nu}<0.195$ eV (for the $\sum m_{\nu}>0$ eV prior).

limitations.text: 作者指出，w0wa CDM模型中与ΛCDM的偏好可能受到先验选择的影响，且部分被偏好的模型可能映射到不违反零能量条件的精质模型，因此不应过度解读 [S5.SS2.p9]。中微子质量上限强烈依赖于∑mν的先验选择，并且在改变背景几何的扩展模型中会显著放宽 [S7.SS1.p7][S7.SS1.p9]。此外，DESI与SDSS在0.6<z<0.8红移区间的BAO测量存在约3σ的差异，其原因尚不清楚，可能是样本方差涨落 [S3.SS3.p5]。

evidence.quote: However, we caution against over-interpretation of this result, since at least some of the $\left(w_{0},w_{a}\right)$ models preferred by our analysis could be mapped to quintessence models which reproduce the observable quantities $D_{M}/r_{d}$ and $D_{H}/r_{d}$ to high precision even though they do not violate the null energy condition at any redshift
We also caution that the upper bound obtained is strongly dependent on the choice of prior for $\sum m_{\nu}$.
However, we repeat the caveat that the limits are substantially relaxed in more extended dark energy models that affect the background geometry, such as those in Section 5.
The cause of this difference is not clear.

The cause of the difference may simply an unlucky sample variance fluctuation—if so, this will soon become clear with later DESI data releases, which will have a much larger $V_{\rm eff}$ in this redshift range.
